content.value_statement: Inconsistent component metadata makes library migration and procurement checks harder. This guide outlines CSV normalization and gap reporting, while automated enforcement requires separately supplied tools.
actual_capabilities: Describes a cleanup workflow for component CSV metadata, including manufacturers, footprints, and manufacturer part numbers.
Outlines whitespace trimming, manufacturer title casing, and lifecycle string normalization.
Identifies validation targets such as required symbol names, missing fields, and description length limits.
Illustrates row-level gap reporting for missing manufacturer part numbers.
Describes cleaned CSV export and customization of team naming conventions.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; the referenced validator, schema definitions, templates, and tests are absent.
The documented workflow supports CSV only, not direct editing of native EDA library formats.
Automated validation and repeatable enforcement require separately supplied scripts and explicit validation rules.
Manufacturer part number accuracy, live lifecycle status, and EDA import compatibility are not independently verified by this guide.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Legacy Library Migration
use_cases.description: Use the documented cleanup checklist to define field mappings, normalization rules, and missing-field checks before migrating component CSVs.

use_cases.title: Review Supplier Component Metadata
use_cases.description: Plan checks for missing part numbers, inconsistent manufacturer strings, and lifecycle labels in supplier CSV deliveries.

use_cases.title: Define Shared Library Standards
use_cases.description: Translate the guide into explicit naming rules and validation requirements for a separately maintained CSV processing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Cleanup Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this guide, list the checks for my component CSV. Identify required inputs and distinguish available guidance from missing automation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review before processing a library

prompt_templates.title: Review a Small CSV Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component CSV sample: [paste sample]. Suggest whitespace, manufacturer, and lifecycle normalization. Flag missing fields without inventing part numbers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Manual review of a small component sample

prompt_templates.title: Specify Team Validation Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these columns and requirements: [insert details], propose CSV validation rules and a row-level gap report format. Mark unspecified limits as unresolved.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate definition of team library standards

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Verified Cleanup Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my supplied validator, schema, and sample CSV. Propose a cleanup plan and tests. Preserve originals and distinguish verified results from planned actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration with separately supplied validation tools

output_examples.input: Review a sample containing manufacturer ' acme ', lifecycle 'active', and an empty manufacturer part number.
output: Proposed manufacturer: Acme, using whitespace trimming and the guide's title-case convention.
Proposed lifecycle: Active, subject to the team's allowed lifecycle values.
Missing manufacturer part number: flagged for review; no replacement value inferred.

output_examples.input: Prepare a validation plan for a component CSV requiring symbols, footprints, and manufacturer part numbers.
output: Check each row for missing symbols, footprints, and manufacturer part numbers.
Report the row and field for each missing value.
Confirm the description length limit and lifecycle vocabulary before normalization.
Automated processing requires a separately supplied validator and schema; no file processing is claimed.

best_practices: Supply explicit required columns, lifecycle values, naming conventions, and description limits before requesting validation.
Preserve the original CSV and review proposed changes on a small sample before applying them broadly.
Verify separately supplied scripts and tests before relying on automated results or importing cleaned data into EDA tools.
anti_patterns: Assuming this documentation package includes the advertised Python validator, schema, or test suite.
Inventing missing manufacturer part numbers, footprints, or lifecycle values to make validation appear complete.
Treating formatted CSV output as proof of component authenticity or compatibility with every EDA import configuration.

faq.question: Does this package include a working validator?
faq.answer: No. It contains SKILL.md only. The referenced validator, schema definitions, and tests must be supplied separately.

faq.question: Which data format does the workflow cover?
faq.answer: The guide covers CSV files. It does not provide direct support for native EDA library files.

faq.question: Which fields does the guide discuss?
faq.answer: It discusses manufacturer names, manufacturer part numbers, footprints, symbol names, lifecycle strings, descriptions, and missing-field reports.

faq.question: Can it recover missing part numbers?
faq.answer: The documented workflow flags missing part numbers. It provides no authoritative lookup mechanism for recovering or verifying them.

faq.question: Can I customize the validation rules?
faq.answer: The guide describes customization, but executable rules require your own schema and validator. Provide exact naming rules, required fields, and length limits.

faq.question: Does it guarantee imports into Altium Designer, KiCad, or Eagle?
faq.answer: No. The guide mentions these tools, but includes no import adapters or compatibility tests. Verify field mappings against your target tool.
